description: Collects and cleans business data and analyses it to find trends. Builds dashboards and reports so teams can make decisions.
Builds trains and deploys machine learning models. Turns experiments into reliable services with APIs and containers so models can be used in real products.
Builds intelligent applications using deep learning and large language models. Designs retrieval based assistants and prompts and connects models to real products through APIs.
Builds systems that understand and generate human language such as text classifiers search and chat assistants. Fine tunes transformer models and prepares text data for training.
Builds systems that understand images and video such as object detection and image classification. Trains neural networks and processes image data for real applications.
Uses statistics and machine learning to answer business questions and build predictive models. Explores data with Python and communicates findings with clear visualisations.
Builds backend services and automation tools in Python. Designs REST APIs and works with databases and uses version control to ship reliable code.
Builds complete web applications covering both the user interface and the server. Connects a frontend to databases through REST APIs and deploys working products.
